Name: Rekindle - A Kent and Jodi Event Expansion
Author: AirynS
Description:
[center][color=#f1c232][size=6][b]REKINDLE - A Kent and Jodi Event Expansion[/b][/size][/color][/center][size=3]

Like many of the vanilla non-romanceable characters, Jodi and Kent are both fairly one-note characters. Rekindle aims to give them more depth and characterisation by adding three new event storylines: one for Kent and his recovery process, one for Jodi and her desire to grow beyond the role of 'mother', and one for their relationship together. 

[/size][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Includes:[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]12 new events: 4 for Kent, 3 for Jodi, and 5 combined[/size]
[*][size=3]Post-event schedule changes for Jodi and Kent so that they visit their friends, spend couple time together, and enjoy their hobbies[/size]
[*][size=3]Over 140 lines of new schedule-based and post-event reaction dialogue[/size]
[*][size=3]Post-event vanilla dialogue edits to reflect character growth[/size]
[*][size=3]A new part-time job for Kent[/size]
[/list][size=3]
This mod can be installed in an existing save game (particularly if you are still in Year 1 and haven't met Kent yet), but likely will not have the intended progression if you are already above 6 hearts with Jodi and/or Kent. Rekindle's content will not start until you have seen Kent's 3 heart event and the next event in each chain won't trigger until a certain amount of time has passed [size=3](see the event guide for further details)[/size].

The farmer is not present in the majority of these events and has very few choices to make. [b]There is no romance content between the farmer and Jodi or Kent. This is not a homewrecker mod.[/b][/size]


[color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14535]Kent Gets Therapy - 3 Heart Event Edit[/url].[/size]


[color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]Rekindle includes compatibility with the following mods:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats[/url]﻿: If Jorts & Jean are installed, Rekindle's Therapy event will also require having seen J&J's side event involving Kent. It makes minor edits to this event so that it requires having seen Kent's vanilla 3 heart event for a smoother story progression.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13623]Kent Does the Dishes[/url]﻿: Rekindle's schedule edits will adjust to Kent Does the Dishes's changes and work seamlessly together.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]﻿: If CFDE is installed, Rekindle will also edit some of its dialogue lines for Jodi, Kent, and Sam after seeing the appropriate events to reflect Rekindle's character development.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4217]No More War - Kent as Journalist[/url]﻿: Rekindle does not make any direct mention of Kent's role in Gotoro, so it is compatible with DSV and No More War's edits to his vanilla storyline
[/size]
[*][size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17775]Part of a Saloon Breakfast[/url]﻿: If Part of a Saloon Breakfast is installed, Rekindle will account for its changes to Kent and Jodi's schedules after seeing both its Kent (the) Cook event and Rekindle's Job Offer and/or Ladies' Day events and content from both mods will work together seamlessly.[/size][/size]
[/list]
[size=3]Though it doesn't include specific compatibility, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31246?]No More Floor Fish [/url]﻿is recommended as a companion mod to improve the writing of Jodi's vanilla 4 heart event.

Rekindle may or may not be compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. I will not add compatibility if it is not.[/size]


[color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Content Warnings
[/b][/size][/color][size=3]Kent's storyline involves mentions of PTSD, trauma recovery, and mental health struggles. This is treated respectfully and with a focus on healing, but may still be difficult for some players. The Camping Trip event in particular includes an in-event warning and a reminder that the event can be skipped if needed.


[color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size][/color]
People are welcome to upload translations as long as no AI is used in the translation process and only the translated i18n file is uploaded.[/size]
